description: The Department for Transport's maritime and shipping statistics collection brings together data on UK ports, shipping, sea passengers, waterborne freight and seafarers. It includes quarterly and annual port freight statistics, sea passenger statistics for all routes, shipping fleet statistics and statistics on seafarers in the UK shipping industry, and the earlier series on waterborne freight moved within the UK by water. Coverage is national for the United Kingdom. The statistics are free under the Open Government Licence and published online on GOV.UK; the collection was last updated on 10 September 2026 with port freight for April to June 2026. Caveats: figures are statistical aggregates, not vessel movements, and older waterborne freight releases on data.gov.uk point to archived pages. The tonnages by port and route support port capacity planning, freight network flow and analysis of disruptions to shipping. They complement the Danish AIS data and the Port of Switzerland statistics for inland ports.
